answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 1224 Country: India Title: If someone has performed Umra one time. Is it compulsory for him/her to perform haj also? Waiting your reply according to Quran and Sunnah. Question: As sam o alaikum, If someone has performed Umra one time. Is it compulsory for him/her to perform haj also? Waiting your reply according to Quran and Sunnah. With regards! Answer ID: 1224 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 364=356/D) If Hujj was not obligatory on him and he went for Umrah in Hujj months (i.e. Shawwal , Zulqad and 8 days of Zulhijj ) then Hujj will be obligatory on him, whether he performs it the same year or later. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
